prayerExcerpt.en-US: The heroic act which merited for St. John Gualbert his conversion was the forgiveness of his enemy.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: O ato heroico que mereceu para São João Gualberto sua conversão foi o perdão de seu inimigo.

meta.face: A Florentine of about seventy, lean from austerity, with a fair, lightly weathered complexion and a face BROADEST ACROSS HIGH, JUTTING CHEEKBONES, the cheeks falling FLAT beneath them to a NARROW, SQUARE-TIPPED chin; a medium straight nose with a slightly BULBOUS tip, WIDE-SET, pale grey eyes under sparse, ARCHED grey brows, a small, firm mouth under a pronounced upper-lip groove; a short, close, silver-grey beard following the jaw, grey hair in a monastic crown; the gaze lowered to the crucifix, gentle.
meta.basis: No portrait from life survives. Neri di Bicci (Santa Trinita) and Luca di Tommè paint him old, in a grey-brown habit, with a short grey beard and a monastic crown; Wikipedia gives c. 985 – 1073 and the bowing crucifix of San Miniato. The card follows the old painters, with the cheekbones and chin as our choice.
